claims.claim: Cai identifies Dryad 10.5061/dryad.8q0p192 as the source and states that raw variables include incident T2D and follow-up duration.
The Dryad dataset landing page lists Data set Int J Obesity.xlsx, 3.26 MB, as a download; the actual workbook has not been inspected in this task.
Sasagawa randomly assigned participants within J-ECOH to derivation and validation and developed seven-year DeepSurv and Cox models.
For diabetes Sasagawa reports AUROC 0.878 for DeepSurv and 0.872 for Cox; Discussion states no significant AUROC/Brier difference despite improved NRI/IDI.
Sasagawa reports ethical or legal restrictions on public dataset deposition.
